name: madi
description: Local-first Windows authoring tool with Publication IR-based EPUB and HWPX export

scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:epub && pnpm run build:hwpx && pnpm run build:atomic-output && pnpm run build:hwp-bridge && pnpm --filter @madi/desktop build
scripts.build:hwp-bridge:release: dotnet publish sidecars/hwp-bridge/Madi.HwpBridge.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x86 --no-self-contained -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false --output sidecars/hwp-bridge/bin/package/win-x86
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:epub && pnpm run build:hwpx && pnpm run build:atomic-output && pnpm run build:hwp-bridge && pnpm --filter @madi/desktop dev
scripts.test: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:epub && pnpm run build:hwpx && pnpm run build:hwp-bridge && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:typie && pnpm run test:publication && pnpm run test:epub && pnpm run test:hwpx && pnpm run test:hwp-bridge && pnpm run test:epubcheck && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:desktop && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:electron
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run test:phase1a && pnpm run test:phase1b && pnpm run test:phase1d && pnpm run test:phase1e && node scripts/test-madi-roundtrip.mjs && node scripts/test-madi-endurance.mjs && node scripts/test-scene-break.mjs && node scripts/test-recovery-cli.mjs
scripts.pretest:electron: pnpm fixture:phase1d-scale && pnpm fixture:phase1e-scale && pnpm fixture:phase1f-reader && pnpm run build:epub && pnpm run build:hwpx && pnpm run build:hwp-bridge && pnpm --filter @madi/desktop build
scripts.test:electron: node scripts/electron-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-scale-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1e-dev-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1f-dev-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1g-dev-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1h-dev-smoke.mjs
scripts.package:unpacked: pnpm run build:core:release && pnpm run build:epub:release && pnpm run build:hwpx:release && pnpm run build:atomic-output:release && pnpm run build:hwp-bridge:release && pnpm --filter @madi/desktop build && node scripts/package-unpacked.mjs
scripts.pretest:package: pnpm fixture:phase1d-scale && pnpm fixture:phase1e-scale && pnpm fixture:phase1f-reader && pnpm run package:unpacked
scripts.test:package: node scripts/electron-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-packaged-scale-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1e-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1f-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1g-packaged-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-phase1h-packaged-smoke.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:toolchain && pnpm run check:repository && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:desktop && pnpm run test:publication && pnpm run test:epub && pnpm run test:hwpx && pnpm run test:hwp-bridge && pnpm run test:epubcheck && pnpm run test:core && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:epub && pnpm run build:hwpx && pnpm run build:hwp-bridge && pnpm run test:typie && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:bundle && pnpm run test:electron && pnpm run test:package
